segments.he: הַכֹּל נִיקָּח בְּכֶסֶף מַעֲשֵׂר כּוּ׳. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי בַּר חֲנִינָא, חַד מַתְנֵי אַעֵירוּב וְחַד מַתְנֵי אַמַּעֲשֵׂר.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «All» types of food «may be bought with» second-«tithe money,» except for water and salt. «Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yosei bar Ḥanina» both had the same tradition, but «one teaches» it «with regard to eiruv, and one teaches» it «with regard to» the second «tithe.»
